kerberos: Implement option to use login password Adds a use_login_password flag to AcquireTgt. If set, the login password is read from the kernel keyring and used as Kerberos password. In connection with the KerberosAccounts policy and the ${PASSWORD} placeholder this allows admins to prepopulate Kerberos tickets that log in automatically, so users get seamless, transparent Kerberos SSO. Remove @allow_multiple_section_input decorator Certain RPC methods in FAFT were decorated with a custom property, @allow_multiple_section_input, which allowed multiple parameters to be bundled as a tuple. This change removes that custom solution. FAFT tests will now need to call the RPC multiple times in order to achieve the same effect. This change is particularly motivated by the upcoming protobuf, part of go/faft-grpc, which will define the parameters for all RPCs. It will be much clearer to read (section) than (section1, optional tuple_of_sections). CHROMIUM: drm/i915: Add missing access checks in i915_gem_execbuffer2_ioctl CVE-2018-20669: An issue where a provided address with access_ok() is not checked was discovered in i915_gem_execbuffer2_ioctl in drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_gem_execbuffer.c in the Linux kernel through 4.19.13. A local attacker can craft a malicious IOCTL function call to overwrite arbitrary kernel memory, resulting in a Denial of Service or privilege escalation. The problem is fixed upstream with commit 594cc251fdd0 ("make 'user_access_begin()' do 'access_ok()'"), which merges access_ok into user_access_begin() system-wide. Since this would be difficult to backport, add the missing calls to access_ok() locally.
